description: A replay of a change from atelier's history (harness/replay.py): a review fix on atelier-37uq's branch (6f742c79), which makes land's touched-claims walk follow advances links. The defect found after merge (defects.md row 64, atelier-ss25): a commit that only adds an issue advancing a mission re-checks every done issue of that mission. The reviewer of atelier-sodr, in review, started with the task line `submit` prints, in a confined run (harness/confine.py) that cannot read the fix. Pass: a round-1 review by another thread, with a fix-now finding the judge reads as naming the known defect. Reported: whether the code supports each other fix-now finding. Needs EVAL_ATELIER and this repository's history.
